subject: NeoHealth private VPC — commercial terms, platform fee & support options
summary: NeoHealth requested clarity on platform fee and support tiers for a VPC/on-prem deployment. The initial commercial included a platform fee and three support tiers; NeoHealth asked for a first-year waiver and a deeper discount for a 24-month commit. Redwood internal team discussed an approval for a structured credit against the platform fee, added migration assistance, and a time-limited Premium support upgrade. Proposal sent with DocuSign link and updated SOW.
messages:
From: Alex Harlow <alex@neohealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-08T16:20:00Z
Subject: Private VPC pricing detail request — NeoHealth

Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to get a consolidated commercial for a NeoHealth private deployment (VPC). Specifics we need:

- Full pricing table: one-time license vs monthly metered model.
- Platform fee: is this a fixed annual fee or offset against committed spend?
- Support tiers: what's included in Standard / Premium / Enterprise (response SLAs, escalation path, on-call)?
- Migration assistance: do you provide engineering days or runbook support?

We're budgeting for a potential 24-month commitment if the economics look right. Can you send a written proposal + SOW we can circulate to procurement?

Thanks,
Alex Harlow
Head of AI Platforms
NeoHealth
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harlow <alex@neohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-09T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing detail request — NeoHealth

Alex —

Appreciate the clear list. I attached a pricing workbook and a draft SOW that maps to a VPC (cloud-hosted in your VPC) deployment. High-level highlights from the attachment:

- Licensing: two options shown — annual license (fixed) or metered (per-GPU-hour + per-token) with a lower platform fee.
- Platform fee: baseline $120k/year (covers control plane, telemetry, model catalog). We can credit platform fee against committed spend.
- Support tiers: Standard (10x5, email support, monthly business review), Premium (24/7, 2-hr P1 SLA, 3 dedicated escalation contacts), Enterprise (onsite option, named TAM, quarterly architecture reviews).
- Migration assistance: we include up to 3 engineer-days for onboarding; additional days are billable or available as a one-time credit with a commit.

If you anticipate a 24-month commitment with a defined committed throughput, we can propose a blended discount that reduces per-token and per-GPU-hour prices and apply credits to the platform fee.

Next steps: 30-minute commercial review tomorrow? If you prefer, I can run a short counter that ties specific savings to committed GPU hours.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_VPC_pricing_v2.xlsx; SOW-NeoHealth-draft.pdf
From: Alex Harlow <alex@neohealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@neohealth.com>
Date: 2026-01-10T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing detail request — NeoHealth

Vanessa —

Thanks for the deck and SOW. A couple of asks from procurement and finance:

- Platform fee: can Redwood waive the platform fee for year one if we sign a 24-month agreement with a baseline committed GPU-hours? That helps our capital planning.
- Support: Premium looks aligned, but procurement wants Premium included for the first 6 months at no extra cost while we stabilize.
- Migration: we need 5 engineer-days for initial migration/runbook handover — can that be included?

If you can get close to that, we can move the DocuSign process quickly.

Best,
Alex
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-12T15:00:00Z
Subject: NeoHealth negotiation — proposed concession and approval requested

Team —

Quick summary: NeoHealth asks for a year-one platform fee waiver, Premium for 6 months, and 5 migration engineer-days in exchange for a 24-month commit. Deal is mid-six figures ARR potential and strategic in the health vertical (HIPAA considerations).

Proposed counter (to send externally):
- Platform fee: convert to a credit equal to 50% of first-year platform fee applied as invoice credit over the first 12 months (preserves revenue recognition patterns).
- Support: Premium included for first 6 months; after that standard tier applies unless they convert to Enterprise.
- Migration: include 5 engineer-days as a one-time onboarding credit.
- Commit: require a minimum committed GPU-hours baseline (we propose 60k GPU-hours / year) and a 10% uplift to pricing if they fail to hit 60% of committed usage in year one.

Impact / approvals needed: finance — this is a structured credit (will need ledger note). Rishi — we are asking for a discount outside the normal 25% cap; can you approve up to 35% blended discount? Legal — fast-track SOW review and add a performance credit clause.

If approved, I'll send the counter with an updated SOW and DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Vanessa

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harlow <alex@neohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-14T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing detail request — NeoHealth (updated offer)

Alex —

Appreciate the clarity on what Procurement needs. Attached is an updated, signable package. High level — our counter is designed to balance your request with predictable unit economics for both teams:

- Platform fee: Redwood will apply a structured credit equal to 50% of the first-year platform fee. The credit will be applied evenly as invoice credits across the first 12 months. (See SOW and invoice schedule.)
- Support: Premium tier included for the first 6 months at no additional charge; we will schedule a kickoff to align on P1/P2 runbooks and escalation contacts.
- Migration assistance: we will include 5 engineer-days of migration support (remote) as a one-time credit; additional days available at standard rates.
- Commit: 24-month agreement with a 60k GPU-hours/year minimum. Failure to meet 60% of committed usage in year one triggers a 10% price uplift on metered units for year two (protects capacity economics).

Action items for NeoHealth:
1) Review the attached SOW (SOW-NeoHealth-revA.pdf).
2) If acceptable, sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/NEO-2026-071
3) We will then circulate an onboarding calendar and a 2-week migration plan.

If you'd like one more calibration call before signature, I'm available tomorrow morning.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachments: SOW-NeoHealth-revA.pdf
